header.name: Dragnode Visualization from Inventory Depletions
header.description: Given an inventory id, aggregate upstream and downstream depletions and calculate positions for dragnode chart returning a data object with data and connector entries for use in dragnode chart

data.transform:
const maxVal =  $.max.val

const width = 200
const height = 50
const row = 30
const tier = 120
const color = "#ffc000"
const max = maxVal * width + (maxVal+1) *row



const data=[]
const connector=[]



const uNodes = [...$.nodes]
const uWidth = [...$.width]
const dY = tier
 data.push({

      "id": Object.keys(uNodes[0])[0],
      "label": Object.keys(uNodes[0])[0].split(":").join("{br}"),
      "color": "#00ff00",
      "x": row,
      "y": dY,
      "shape":"rectangle",
      "width":width,
      "height":height
    
})
for (let i=0; i<uNodes.length; i++) {

  for (const [k,v] of Object.entries(uNodes[i])) {
 let vWidth = 0   
    
    v.forEach((e,ii)=>{
      data.push({
        "id": e.id,
        "label": e.id.split(":").join("{br}"),
        "color": color,
        "x": width*ii/2 + (ii+1)*row,//uWidth[i] === maxVal ? ((max/uWidth[i])*(vWidth+ii))+row : max/(uWidth[i]+1)*(vWidth+ii+1),
        "y": dY+height*i/2 + tier*(i+1),
        "shape":"rectangle",
        "width":width,
        "height":height
      })
      
    })
    vWidth+=1
    
    connector.push(...v.map(e=>({  
      "from": k,
      "to": e.id,
      "label": e.qty,
      "color": "#29C3BE",
      "strength": "1",
      "arrowatstart": "1",
      "arrowatend": "0",
      "alpha": "100"
    })))
}
}


return ({
  "data": {
    "data":data,
    "connector":connector
  }
})
